text: Implemented JS-only surface-view-three as a thin injected-Three.js adapter. The typed program/interpreter owns geometry/color resource caches, dirty classes, on-demand drawing, resize, explicit absent/lost/disposed errors, and raycast face/closest-vertex picks; no Three.js types escape the adapter. Added fixed SurfViewJS semantic fixtures for scalar thresholds, categorical labels, and ordered opacity/blend compositing. surfaceViewThreeJS/test passes 6/6. Live Chrome/real WebGL receipt passed with visible geometry and valid center picks: 32,768 vertices/64,770 faces, 1,956,888 uploaded bytes, compile 34.2 ms, upload+first submission 191.8 ms, pick 4.9 ms; 163,842 vertices/326,020 faces, 9,810,552 bytes, compile 58.1 ms, upload+first submission 23.2 ms, pick 12.6 ms. Forced-frame CPU submission p95 was 0.2/0.1 ms; this is not GPU-complete latency. The live run caught and fixed dynamic dispatch, duplicate shader color declaration, and generic-camera raycaster incompatibilities. Browser harness and local SurfViewJS Three-module instructions are in modules/surface-view-three.
